activity.notes: Zhao Gou became Emperor Gaozong in 1127. His reign was interrupted by a forced abdication in 1129, so this Activity records the first reign segment only; sub-year boundaries are intentionally not asserted here.

sources.title: Song: Emperors: 1127-1276 — Archontology
sources.citation_text: The chronology records Gaozong (Zhao Gou) ruling from 1127 until a 1129 interruption, followed by restoration later in 1129.

sources.title: Song Dynasty Emperor Portraits — Emperor Gaozong — National Palace Museum
sources.citation_text: The National Palace Museum identifies Song Gaozong, personal name Zhao Gou, and records his reign from 1127 to 1162 overall.
